The '''Bone Kings''' were one of two major [[Prison/Legends|prison]] gangs within the [[Cog Hive Seven]] prison by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Led by [[Vasco Nailhead|Vas Nailhead]], the Bone Kings' greatest rival was the [[Gravity Massive]] gang.
